verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v1: yā ʿāshirūna ḥabāʾiba ʾalihāʾimi min wuddihi ḥaẓẓu yuwaffiru qāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v2: wayaẓallu yufʾadu qalbuhu wafuʾāduhu shayʾāni mā qaḍayā biḥājati rāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v3: wad-damʿu yuqniʿuhu biqūti ṭāʾili waʾanīsu hadhā l-ʾilfi sajʿu ḥamāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v4: ṭayfu l-khayāli yaṭūfuhu mataʾawwibā min ḥubbihi ʾashlāhu ʾakhdha karāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v5: wasaqāhu kaʾasa sh-shuhdi ʿan dhawqi l-karā wanaṣībuhu yūlā liḥiṣṣati nāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v6: khallū sabīla mutayyami liyutimma mā yanwīhi yā ʿudhālu wafqa lawāzimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v7: ʾalḥaḥtumūhu watahdhurūna bilawmiti la la ʿalayhi ʾukhayyā lawmatu laʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v8: la tuṣghiyanna safāsifa l-kalimāti man lāḥa lahu l-ʾilḥāḥu laysa biṣāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v9: billāhi yā zuwwāru ʿāni khalfakum billāhi yā zuwwāru rawḍaḍi sālimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v11: qūlū lahu ʾabqaytumūnī jāʾila tīhu ṣ-ṣabābati ʿāniyā bigharāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v12: qūlū lahu lawlā z-zamān yaʿūqunī laʾataytuhu ʾaqḍī lubānata hāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v13: wamatā fataltu ḥibāla zawri muḥkimā jāʾat fayankuthuhā maqādiru ḥākimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v14: ʾaʿnī sh-sharīfa l-fāṭimiyyā sharāfata fayḍa l-ʿalī najla n-nabiyyī wahāshimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v15: quṭbu l-wujūdi wujūduhu mutadaffiqu tasrī sarāʾiruhu linafʿi ʿawālimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v16: baḥru l-ḥaqīqati dhū l-maʿārifi ʿaylamu wal-barzakhu l-maʿlūmu kanzu mulazimu
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v17: man qadruhu bayna l-ʾanāmi ʾanāfahu mawlahu maʿ mā qad ḥawā bimakārimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v18: man mithluhu baʿda l-wirāthati jadduhu man mithluhu ḥīna ʿtaraftu maẓālimī
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v19: man mithluhu ḥawza l-maṭālibi kullihā lammā ḥawā minhā ḍamānatu qāsimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v20: man mithluhu man qāsa fīhi māʾāthirā yahiman faʾakrim bil-walīdi wakhātimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v21: willāhu ʾashrafa naʿtahu manʿūtahu wakamā yashā ḥaqqu z-zaʿīmi ʿālimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v22: tamyīzuhu wakamā ḥawāhu biḥālihi bīḍu l-ʾanūqi ṭilabuhu maḥārimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v23: jāʾat manāqibuhu kashamsi ẓahīrati fī kulli buldāni ẓahūra maʿālimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v25: ʾaʿnī ʾabā l-ʿabbāsi ʾaḥmada dhā l-ʿulā huwa badru fāsi ʿammahā bimakārimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v26: yā man ṣadā l-ḥājāti yā riyyā ṣ-ṣadā bimiyāhi waṣli lil-jalīli waqāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v27: yā ʾaḥmada t-tijāni yā qamara l-hudā layla ḍ-ḍalalati hādiyā bihawāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v28: kam ʾāsifi fariqi liʿiṭfika ʾāwiyā ʾanqadhtahu bijināyati wamaʾāthimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v29: ʾinnī ʾalīfu l-wuddi fī ʾilfī sarā faʾaghith bimalhūfi l-ʿubaydi khādimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v30: ʾinnī ktafaytu biṭalli wablika nāʾilā fayḍa l-yadayni yuhīmu ḥājata rāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v31: maṭaru s-samāʾi yakūnu yaqlaʿu tārata lakinna jawda l-jūdi laysa biṣārimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v32: hadhā ʾawānu buḥta fīhi maḍarrata mā laysa ʿindī la taqūlu bidāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v33: mā ʿazza ʾidrāku l-munā min baʿdimā wajjahtu wajhī naḥwa khayri ʾakārimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v34: lim lā waʾanta majādatī wamakānatī waḍamānatī wasaʿādatī malāzimī
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v35: waʾighāthatī ʾiʿānatī kifāyatī wahidāyatī ḥimāyatī limaẓālimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v37: walaqad basaṭtu yudayyata l-muḥtāji lil- kanzi l-mudakhkhari mahbiṭi lizamāzim
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v38: kanzu lisānu l-ḥāli yushhidu nādiyā wayaqūlu hal min ḥāzimi mutazāḥimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v39: maftūḥu bābi ṣāḥi laysa bimughlaqi man shāʾa yadkhuluhu yanal bamaghānimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v40: ʾannā tuʿʿadu manāqibu wamaḥāsinu wamaḥāmidu bika ʾabḥuru warawākimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v43: maʿnāka baḥru lā yuqāwamu qaʿruhu min sāʿifa l-ʾilhāma laysa bifāhimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v44: khuṣṣiṣta mā khuṣṣiṣta mā laka fī l-warā thāni warithta bijaddika l-mutarāḥimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v46: wabīʾālihi l-ʾaṣḥābi ʾanjumi sharʿihi bīḍi l-wujūhi wabīḍihim waʿamāʾimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v10: ʾin jiʾitumu mutaʿʿafirīna khudūdakum matayammimīna maʿa azdiḥāmi zamāzimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v24: walahu l-kunā wkadhāka ṭāra ṣ-ṣītu fī l-ʾaqṭāri ʾakrim bish-sharīfi waḥāzimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v36: min ʾayn yūʿidunī z-zamānu wahālanī ʾin kunta tuṣghī yā ʾamīnu ghamāghimī
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v42: lam ʾūfi ḥaqqaka madḥaha lakinnanī l-maṣdūru sirrī wahwa laysa bikātimi
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v45: thumma ṣ-ṣalatu kadhā s-salamu lʾaḥmada l-mabʿūthi ḥaqqā wil-ʾimāmi wakhātami
verses.ya-ashiruna-c1-v41: min fayḍika l-mashhūdi kulla shahādti jamʿu l-murīdi bimā ḥaḍarta ḥarāzmi
